returned_tweets.author: OpenAI
returned_tweets.text: Introducing a limited preview of GPT-5.6 Sol, our next generation frontier model, as well as GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-5.6 Luna.

returned_tweets.author: OpenAI
returned_tweets.text: We plan to make GPT-5.6 generally available in coming weeks. For now, at the request of the U.S. government, we're starting with a limited preview among trusted partners in Codex and the API.

returned_tweets.author: OpenAI
returned_tweets.text: Sol is our new flagship and a step function better than GPT-5.5. Terra is competitive to GPT-5.5 at 2x lower cost. Luna is our most cost-efficient model.

returned_tweets.author: OpenAI
returned_tweets.text: GPT-5.6 Sol sets a new state of the art on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

returned_tweets.author: OpenAI
returned_tweets.text: GPT-5.6 Sol is our most capable model yet for cybersecurity, shifting the frontier for long-horizon security tasks including vulnerability research and exploitation.

returned_tweets.author: OpenAI
returned_tweets.text: GPT-5.6 Sol launches with our most robust safety stack yet, hardened with human red teaming and over 700,000 A100-equivalent GPU hours of automated testing.

returned_tweets.author: sama
returned_tweets.text: Good news: Sol is a smart, efficient step forward, same price as GPT-5.5; Terra has 5.5-level performance at half the price. Bad news: at the request of the US government, it launches today in limited preview instead of the open access launch we were planning. We are working with the government to get to general availability as fast as we can. It fits our long-held strategy of iterative deployment but isn't quite the process we think is optimal.

returned_tweets.author: sama
returned_tweets.text: Also, I am happy to answer questions if people have some.

returned_tweets.author: sama
returned_tweets.text: actually i think a required preview period for extended redteaming is not a bad idea. i just dont like the idea of the government picking the customers. confident we will get to a better place.

returned_tweets.author: sama
returned_tweets.text: oh and also...750 token/sec coming to 5.6 sol in july!

returned_tweets.author: AndrewCurran_
returned_tweets.text: Semafor reports the US government has lifted its block on Mythos 5 in a letter from Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to Tom Brown. Fable not included. US only, covers 100 US institutions including major companies and government agencies.

returned_tweets.author: SophiaCai99
returned_tweets.text: Commerce partially lifts export ban on Anthropic's Mythos 5, allowing 100 trusted partners including companies and gov agencies. Fable 5 still restricted.

returned_tweets.author: AnthropicAI
returned_tweets.text: To keep pace with AI progress, we're advancing how we study Claude's economic impact, using hourly sampling and survey data.

returned_tweets.author: AnthropicAI
returned_tweets.text: This Econ Index is the first to survey Claude users. Over 1/3 expect AI to do most or nearly all their work tasks within a year, and heavy delegators are most optimistic about pay and job security.

returned_tweets.author: AlexFinn
returned_tweets.text: Ornith-1.0 35b is the best local model I've run that doesn't require 200GB+ of RAM. Smarter and faster than Qwen 3.6 in my tests, runs well on a DGX Spark.

returned_tweets.author: GergelyOrosz
returned_tweets.text: GLM-5.2 plus the US banning the most capable new models means open source caught up to SOTA closed source coding models. Could be problematic for Anthropic and OpenAI revenue projections and IPO plans.

returned_tweets.author: rileywestreel
returned_tweets.text: Amodei and Hassabis, same stage, on when AGI lands: Amodei 1-2 years, Hassabis 5-10. Amodei: assume I'm right it can be done in 1-2 years, why can't we slow down to Demis' timeline?

returned_tweets.author: cryptorover
returned_tweets.text: Musk says AI demand is now so extreme that production shortages have become insane. At the same time, Tim Cook says tech cost inflation is the worst he has seen in 40 years.

returned_tweets.author: AnatoliKopadze
returned_tweets.text: Anthropic CEO: there are jobs that took generations to build that may disappear. 31-minute interview; the economy splits into people who use AI and people who get displaced.

returned_tweets.author: jmrphy
returned_tweets.text: After a week with beta testers, I believe we have the ticket to solving slop in LLM output. It's a tiny 14b model fine-tuned with a specific technical innovation.

returned_tweets.author: ThePrimeagen
returned_tweets.text: Reviewing some code, it was good, real good, couldn't believe an LLM did quality work. Asked cursor what phase we were on; it said phase 1. Realized it was my own change.

returned_tweets.author: Jeyxbt
returned_tweets.text: Shopify head of engineering: I'd contend 90% of your code should be written by AI now. It's just better at it than you are.
